notes.title: OrcinUS: Nature Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

We're pleased to share a new update to [b]OrcinUS: Orca Pod Rescue[/b]. We have added [b]10 new unlockable items[/b] that can be earned by progressing through the game! These items all are natural objects found underwater - some of them are even items that wild orcas have been observed using or playing with. We hope this update adds to your enjoyment while exploring the seas!

New Accessories:
[list]
[*] Salmon
[*] Pebbles
[*] Seaweed
[*] Conch Shell
[*] Jellyfish
[*] Kelp
[*] Seashells
[*] Coral
[*] Starfish
[*] Clam
[/list]

Thanks,
Sea Panda Creative

notes.title: Update to "Legend" Achievement
notes.content:
In response to some user feedback, the threshold for unlocking the "Legend" achievement has been reduced from 50000 points to 5000 points. If you have already scored 5000 points or more on a past run, this achievement should automatically unlock whenever you finish your next run.

Thanks for playing!
